symptom.actual: Rust task acceptance and delivery contracts contained the deterministic check 'html'.
symptom.expected: Only checks declared under the requirement's Markdown Deterministic Checks section are authoritative when that section exists.

final_provider_request_evidence.propagation: The malformed PM contract was faithfully carried into CE and Director final physical requests; the defect is contract extraction, not request-context omission.

root_cause.mechanism: _extract_deterministic_checks_from_directive scanned the complete requirement text. It matched '<html>' inside a conditional acceptance explanation for Web projects even though L1-05 is Rust CLI and the authoritative Deterministic Checks section lists only rust_compile, min_files, content_any, and source_target_coverage.
root_cause.general_impact: Any language or artifact can inherit verifier checks mentioned only in examples, conditional prose, or unrelated sections.

fix.behavior: When a Markdown Deterministic Checks or 确定性检查 heading exists, scope extraction until the next same-or-higher-level heading and accept only fence-external explicit bullet, ordered-list, or exact bare-token declarations. Nested headings remain inside the section. Preserve the legacy whole-text fallback when no section exists, with identifier boundaries preventing substring matches such as no_html_for_cli.
fix.compatibility: An explicit html item inside the authoritative section remains supported.
